Onboarding
==========

1. Read the notes in ~/Documents.
2. The team wiki is at http://wiki.internal/.
3. Report the quarter's totals in report.md.

elements.text: Everything the workstation needs is under ~/Documents. Expenses are recorded per month in expenses.csv.
Travel and software are reported separately. The quarterly total is the sum of every row in expenses.csv.
